text: Close-out 2026-09-17: PairConstruction.between under Selection.All now delegates to DirectedPairSchedule (single pairing path for the pure API, resumable execution and previews); PairConstructionLawSuite checks between, paged schedules and bottom-k against an independent brute-force oracle; StudyGuideOracleSuite pins scalar, multiscale and failure rows to literals produced from commit 6218627.
